lines.text: A day to eat anything you want.

data.mean: A day to eat anything you want.
data.define: A day when you stop a strict diet and enjoy treats.

misuse.text: Don't say 'cheat day' about exam day.
misuse.why: Cheating on exams breaks the rules.

data.l1_hook: السبت. "cheat day"؟ نظام غذائي؟ أي نظام غذائي؟
data.l1_ex: يوم السبت هو الـ "cheat day" الخاص بي.

native.tip: “cheat day” = يوم السماح بالأكل. مثال: “Saturday is my cheat day.”
